title: NARPS
description: Raw and preprocessed fMRI data for the mixed gambles task from the Neuroimaging Analysis Replication and Prediction Study.

title: Natural Object Dataset
description: Neuroimaging dataset studying how the brain processes visual stimuli from the natural environment.

title: Balloon Analog Risk-taking Task
description: Functional MRI dataset for the Balloon Analog Risk Task, also known as BART.

title: Neural representations of events arise from temporal community structure
description: fMRI data from an experiment investigating neural representations of events and temporal community structure.

title: Reading-related functional activity in children with spelling deficits and dyslexia
description: Raw 3 Tesla fMRI and T1 structural imaging data from children with typical reading skills, spelling deficits, and dyslexia.

title: The Podcast ECoG Dataset
description: Electrocorticography data for modeling neural activity during natural story listening.

title: pyFR Delayed Free Recall Electrophysiology Study
description: Behavioral and electrophysiology data from a preliminary delayed free-recall study.

title: HUP iEEG Epilepsy Dataset
description: Intracranial EEG dataset collected from participants with epilepsy.

title: sEEG Forced Two-Choice Task
description: Stereoelectroencephalography data recorded during a forced two-choice response task in an epilepsy monitoring setting.

title: Interictal iEEG During Slow-wave Sleep with HFO Markings
description: Intracranial EEG recordings from 20 subjects with high-frequency oscillation event markings.

title: Plitt and Giocomo (2021): Experience-dependent contextual codes in the hippocampus
description: Virtual-reality track data aligned with two-photon calcium imaging in mouse hippocampal CA1.

title: Allen Institute Visual Coding: Optical Physiology
description: Allen Institute Brain Observatory visual-coding dataset with optical physiology recordings.

title: Allen Institute: TF x SF Tuning in Mouse Visual Cortex
description: Two-photon calcium imaging dataset measuring visual responses in mouse visual cortex.

title: C. elegans Whole-brain NeuroPAL and Calcium Imaging
description: Whole-brain structural images and unstimulated calcium imaging from immobilized C. elegans.

title: Spontaneous Inhibitory Currents in CA1 Pyramidal Neurons
description: Spontaneous inhibitory postsynaptic currents recorded from CA1 pyramidal neurons in adult wild-type and Tg2576 mice.
